answer: Every settlement, each identity files one nullifier derived from its private genesis key at the inlet registry, and no key may file twice. A bonded bridge operator relays filings to the mesa bench; when two names prove reducible to one key, the younger clone is deleted and its 10,000 POA bond burns outright. Farming 100 fakes therefore torches 1,000,000 POA per settlement, a bill no epoch reward repays.
